capabilities: Choose a configured project's avatar picture.
description: Set a project's avatar from an image file in that project's folder. Give the project ID from list_projects and the path to a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image, up to 8 MiB; write or generate the image first, then point this tool at it. The picture is resized to a square-fitting WebP and shown wherever the project appears.
name: set_project_avatar
